verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent controls: per-card spending limits for each purpose, VCN controls, expense categorization, and a bare mention of an "Área de aprovações" (approvals area). Nothing documents a codified expense policy with rules by category, role, or context that auto-approves in-policy spend and routes only exceptions to a human. The approvals area is a feature name with no described rule-based auto-approval, and card limits are a related but different control.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human
